description:
Rear
T1 Quince tree x 1 
This quince tree has been inherited with the garden and has not been maintained in a long while. Suggested work:
- Reduce and shape by approx. 1-1.5 meters all round to suitable growth points.

Rear
T2 Apple x 1 (Malus) 
This apple tree is starting to outgrow its location and shade the garden and beds
below. Suggested work:
- Reduce in height by approx. 1 - 1.5 m to suitable growth points.

Rear
T3 Elder x 1 (Sambucus nigra)
This self-set elder is shading the garden and the beds below. Suggested work:
- Reduce to a new height of 1m with the aim to create a tree/bush with much smaller form in the future.

Rear
T4 California Lilac x 1 (Ceanothus spp) 
This ceanothus tree has grown out of its usual bush form and is now in need of some pruning to bring it back into shape.
Suggested work:
- Reduce and shape all round by 0.5 - 1m
